AC-32
AIR CONDITIONING -- BLOWER UNIT
DISASSEMBLY
1. REMOVE BLOWER RESISTOR
Remove the 2 screws and blower resistor.
2. REMOVE AIR REFINER FILTER
(a) Pull out the filter cover.
(b) Remove the filter from the frame.
3. REMOVE BLOWER MOTOR
(a) Remove the screw and wire harness clamp.
(b) Remove the 3 screws and the blower motor.
11mS
